title: ISLAND STEAM AT 9 AM
style:
92 BPM — Light Tropical Acoustic / Café Folk

STYLE TAGS

92 BPM, nylon-string guitar syncopated plucks,
soft island percussion + shaker groove,
warm upright bass hum,
subtle marimba accents,
airy pads drifting,
arrangement builds gently mid-song,
relaxed morning energy,
acoustic, warm, tropical, soft
lyrics:
[Verse 1 – English]
Steam rising slow from porcelain white
Sun on the window, soft golden light
Ocean breathing somewhere near
Morning feels simple, easy here

[Pre-Chorus – Tagalog]
Magandang umaga, tahimik ang dagat
(Good morning, the sea is calm)
Kape sa kamay, puso’y payapa’t
(Coffee in hand, heart at peace)

[Chorus – English + Tagalog]
Island steam at nine a.m.
Sama-sama, here again
Under the sun, buhay ay light
(Life is light)
Sip by sip, the world feels right

[Verse 2 – Cebuano + English]
Maayong buntag, hangin malinaw
(Good morning, the air is clear)
Katawa sa gawas, no worries now
Laughter outside the café door
Simple joy — we need no more

[Bridge – Lift]
Guitar rises, marimba glow
Warm breeze dancing soft and slow
Island rhythm, steady and kind
Coffee, sunlight, quiet mind

[Outro]
Island steam…
Nine a.m…
See you again.

🌊 TRACK 2 — SUNLIT CUP

92 BPM — Acoustic Folk / Tropical Pop Café

STYLE TAGS

92 BPM, light cajón percussion,
gentle shaker,
acoustic guitar fingerstyle,
warm bass,
soft harmony vocals,
mid-song swell with layered guitars,
fade-out relaxed outro
LYRICS

[Verse 1 – English]
Golden rim on a ceramic cup
Slow drip love filling up
Footsteps echo on bamboo floor
Island morning at the door

[Pre-Chorus – Tagalog + English]
Tahimik ang mundo sa oras na ’to
(The world is quiet at this hour)
Soft like the sea breeze touching you

[Chorus – English]
Sunlit cup, we wake so slow
Warmth in every note we know
No rush, no race to run
Just island air and morning sun

[Verse 2 – Cebuano]
Init sa adlaw, kahayag sa mata
(Heat of the sun, brightness in the eyes)
Kape ug pahiyom, kalipay gyud ta
(Coffee and smiles, truly happiness)

[Bridge – English]
Marimba sparkles, light and free
Coffee steam and harmony
We breathe the day before it starts
Island calm in open hearts

[Final Chorus – Mixed]
Sunlit cup, nine a.m.
Sama-sama, once again
Kape, dagat, bright blue sky
Morning says we’re doing fine
